author: claude
summary: Wired the render monitor's cap caption to the real live per-engine effective cap (W-PAR task 014's GET /api/engines/concurrency) instead of the hardcoded SEGMENT_MONITOR_CAP=1 fallback flagged as stale since task 014 shipped.

files.change: New hook. Polls GET /api/engines/concurrency every 5s, exposes engine_id -> effective_cap. Keeps the previous map on a fetch failure (never clears it to empty).
Calls useEngineConcurrency() and passes engineCaps down to GlobalQueue.
Added engineCaps prop, threaded to QueueItem in the active-jobs render loop.

Added engineCaps prop. SegmentRenderMonitor's cap prop is now engineCaps?.[engineType] ?? SEGMENT_MONITOR_CAP -- the constant is now explicitly a fallback (used only when the job's engine has no live entry yet), not the primary value. Updated its comment accordingly.

tests_added: frontend/tests/unit/hooks/useEngineConcurrency.test.ts -- polls on mount, exposes the engine_id->effective_cap map, refreshes on a later poll, keeps the previous map on fetch failure, stops polling on unmount.

frontend/tests/unit/components/queue/QueueItemSegmentMonitor.test.tsx -- two new cases: shows the live cap from engineCaps when present, falls back to SEGMENT_MONITOR_CAP when the job's engine has no entry.
tests_updated: frontend/tests/unit/pages/Activity/ActivityPage.test.tsx -- added fetchEngineConcurrency mock (new hook call would otherwise throw undefined-is-not-a-function in this suite).
verified_live: Confirmed against a real running backend: GET /api/engines/concurrency returns real effective_cap values (xtts=2 in the dev environment, not the hardcoded 1) and the frontend hook fetches it on the Activity page.
